description: IFRS 9 Simplified Approach — ECL provision matrix for trade receivables, IFRS 15 contract assets, and IFRS 16 lease receivables. Ages each receivable into buckets (current / 1-30 / 31-60 / 61-90 / 91-180 / 180+ days past due). Applies the entity's historical loss rates per bucket, adjusted by its stated forwardLookingAdjustment for current conditions and forecasts (IFRS 9.B5.5.35, B5.5.52). Returns per-invoice ECL, portfolio summary, movement schedule (opening − write-offs → closing allowance, P&L charge), and IFRS 7.35H disclosure stub. NOT for the general 3-stage approach (loans, bonds) — use ifr_calculate with standard "ifrs9" for those. Token required; costs 10 credits.

1_30.description: Historical loss rate for 1-30 days past due, a decimal fraction from 0 to 1 (0.04 is 4 %): the share of the balance expected to be lost, which cannot exceed the balance itself.

31_60.description: Historical loss rate for 31-60 days past due, a decimal fraction from 0 to 1 (0.04 is 4 %): the share of the balance expected to be lost, which cannot exceed the balance itself.

61_90.description: Historical loss rate for 61-90 days past due, a decimal fraction from 0 to 1 (0.04 is 4 %): the share of the balance expected to be lost, which cannot exceed the balance itself.

91_180.description: Historical loss rate for 91-180 days past due, a decimal fraction from 0 to 1 (0.04 is 4 %): the share of the balance expected to be lost, which cannot exceed the balance itself.

current.description: Historical loss rate for receivables not yet due, a decimal fraction from 0 to 1 (0.04 is 4 %): the share of the balance expected to be lost, which cannot exceed the balance itself.

over180.description: Historical loss rate for more than 180 days past due, a decimal fraction from 0 to 1 (0.04 is 4 %): the share of the balance expected to be lost, which cannot exceed the balance itself.

bucketRates.description: Required: a rate for every bucket that holds a receivable (current, 1_30, 31_60, 61_90, 91_180, over180). The entity's historical loss rates per ageing bucket, before the forward-looking adjustment (IFRS 9.B5.5.35). Scale DECIMAL_FRACTION: 0.04 is 4 %; a rate below 0 or above 1 is refused (a credit loss cannot exceed the balance).

1_30.description: Forward-looking adjustment of the rate for 1-30 days past due, a decimal fraction above −1 (0.10 raises the rate by a tenth, −0.20 lowers it by a fifth).

31_60.description: Forward-looking adjustment of the rate for 31-60 days past due, a decimal fraction above −1 (0.10 raises the rate by a tenth, −0.20 lowers it by a fifth).

61_90.description: Forward-looking adjustment of the rate for 61-90 days past due, a decimal fraction above −1 (0.10 raises the rate by a tenth, −0.20 lowers it by a fifth).

91_180.description: Forward-looking adjustment of the rate for 91-180 days past due, a decimal fraction above −1 (0.10 raises the rate by a tenth, −0.20 lowers it by a fifth).

current.description: Forward-looking adjustment of the rate for receivables not yet due, a decimal fraction above −1 (0.10 raises the rate by a tenth, −0.20 lowers it by a fifth).

over180.description: Forward-looking adjustment of the rate for more than 180 days past due, a decimal fraction above −1 (0.10 raises the rate by a tenth, −0.20 lowers it by a fifth).

forwardLookingAdjustment.description: Required. The adjustment of the historical rates for current conditions and forecasts of future conditions (IFRS 9.B5.5.52, 5.5.17(c)), as a decimal fraction applied to every bucket's rate (0.10 raises each rate by 10 %, e.g. 0.04 → 0.044; −0.05 lowers it), or an object with one fraction per bucket. 0 where the entity has assessed the forecasts and they change nothing. State the historical rates and this adjustment — never pre-adjusted rates. Scale DECIMAL_FRACTION (10 % is 0.10, not 10): above −1, and an adjustment that takes any bucket's rate above 1 is refused.

id.description: The caller's identifier of the request; returned unchanged.

previousECL.description: The opening loss allowance, 0 or more, for the movement schedule (IFRS 7.35H).

dueDate.description: ISO date the receivable falls due; its days past due at the reporting date decide the bucket. Absent: classified as current.

invoiceDate.description: ISO date of the invoice. Not read: a receivable is aged from its dueDate.

invoiceId.description: Required. The identifier of the receivable; its row in the answer carries it.

outstandingBalance.description: Required. The amount outstanding at the reporting date (the gross carrying amount), 0 or more.

receivables.description: Required, at least one. The trade receivables, contract assets or lease receivables to age and provision.

reportingDate.description: Required. The reporting date the receivables are aged and the expected credit losses measured at (ISO date, e.g. "2025-12-31").

writeOffsInPeriod.description: Required with previousECL: the amounts written off during the period (IFRS 9.5.4.4), 0 or more — they use the allowance, so the charge is closing − (opening − write-offs); a write-off above the opening allowance is itself a loss. 0 where nothing was written off. Not read without previousECL.
